CREATE TABLE documents (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            title TEXT,
            source TEXT,
            url TEXT,
            path TEXT,
            status TEXT,
            tags TEXT,
            created_at TEXT,
            updated_at TEXT,
            last_indexed_at TEXT
        )

CREATE TABLE evidence (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            memory_id TEXT,
            text_snippet TEXT,
            created_at TEXT
        )

CREATE TABLE memories (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CONTEXT',
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      normalized TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'capture',
      source_agent TEXT,
      source_session TEXT,
      source_message_id TEXT,
      confidence REAL DEFAULT 0.6,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
      tags TEXT,
      created_at TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT,
      last_injected_at TEXT,
      last_confirmed_at TEXT,
      ttl_days INTEGER,
      pinned INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      superseded_by TEXT,
      concept TEXT,
      content_time TEXT,
      valid_until TEXT,
      value_score REAL,
      value_label TEXT,
      review_version TEXT,
      review_reason TEXT,
      archived_at TEXT,
      last_reviewed_at TEXT
    , source_layer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', source_path TEXT, source_line INTEGER, source_host TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gigabrain', source_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', sync_policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read_only')

CREATE TABLE memory_beliefs (
      belief_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current',
      confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
      valid_from TEXT,
      valid_to TEXT,
      supersedes_belief_id TEXT,
      source_memory_id TEXT,
      source_layer TEXT,
      source_path TEXT,
      source_line INTEGER,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_claims (
      memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      memory_tier TEXT NOT NULL,
      claim_slot TEXT NOT NULL,
      consolidation_op TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_strength TEXT NOT NULL,
      surface_candidate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_current (
      memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CONTEXT',
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      normalized TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      normalized_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'capture',
      source_agent TEXT,
      source_session TEXT,
      confidence REAL DEFAULT 0.6,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      value_score REAL,
      value_label TEXT,
      created_at TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT,
      archived_at TEXT,
      last_reviewed_at TEXT,
      tags TEXT,
      superseded_by TEXT,
      content_time TEXT,
      valid_until TEXT
    , source_layer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', source_path TEXT, source_line INTEGER, source_host TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gigabrain', source_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', sync_policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read_only')

CREATE TABLE "memory_embeddings" (
      memory_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      model       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'qwen3-embedding:4b',
      embedding   BLOB NOT NULL,
      dims        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2560,
      computed_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_entities (
      entity_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
      aliases TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_entity_aliases (
      alias_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      alias TEXT NOT NULL,
      normalized_alias TEXT NOT NULL,
      confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_entity_mentions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      entity_key TEXT NOT NULL,
      entity_display TEXT NOT NULL,
      role TEXT NOT NULL,
      confidence REAL NOT NULL,
      source TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
      source_path TEXT,
      linked_memory_id TEXT
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_entity_relationships (
      relationship_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      entity_id_a TEXT NOT NULL,
      entity_id_b TEXT NOT NULL,
      relationship_type TEXT,
      evidence_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      source_memory_ids TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
      confidence REAL DEFAULT 0.5,
      created_at TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_episodes (
      episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      summary TEXT NOT NULL,
      start_date TEXT,
      end_date TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',
      primary_entity_id TEXT,
      source_memory_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_eval_history (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      run_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      version TEXT,
      precision_at_1 REAL,
      precision_at_3 REAL,
      precision_at_5 REAL,
      mrr REAL,
      ndcg_at_5 REAL,
      hit_rate REAL,
      case_count INTEGER,
      strategy_accuracy REAL
    , avg_injection_tokens REAL, latency_median_ms REAL, latency_p95_ms REAL)

CREATE TABLE memory_events (
      event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
      component TEXT NOT NULL,
      action TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason_codes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      cleanup_version TEXT NOT NULL,
      run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      review_version TEXT NOT NULL,
      similarity REAL,
      matched_memory_id TEXT,
      payload TEXT
    )

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE memory_fts USING fts5(
        memory_id UNINDEXED,
        content,
        normalized,
        type UNINDEXED,
        tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'
      )

CREATE TABLE memory_native_chunks (
      chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      source_path TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_date TEXT,
      section TEXT,
      line_start INTEGER,
      line_end INTEGER,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      normalized TEXT NOT NULL,
      hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      scope TEXT,
      linked_memory_id TEXT,
      first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
    , memory_type TEXT)

CREATE TABLE memory_native_sync_state (
      source_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      mtime_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
      size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
      hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_synced_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_open_loops (
      loop_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
      priority REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
      related_entity_id TEXT,
      source_memory_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_quality_reviews (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      reviewed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      review_version TEXT NOT NULL,
      action TEXT NOT NULL,
      config_fingerprint TEXT,
      score REAL,
      reason_codes TEXT,
      before_status TEXT,
      after_status TEXT,
      features TEXT
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_relations (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            from_memory_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            to_memory_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            relation_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT,
            source TEXT,
            confidence REAL
        )

CREATE TABLE memory_syntheses (
      synthesis_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      subject_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      stale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
      generated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

tables.name: documents
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            title TEXT,
            source TEXT,
            url TEXT,
            path TEXT,
            status TEXT,
            tags TEXT,
            created_at TEXT,
            updated_at TEXT,
            last_indexed_at TEXT
        )

tables.name: evidence
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE evidence (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            memory_id TEXT,
            text_snippet TEXT,
            created_at TEXT
        )

tables.name: memories
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE memories (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CONTEXT',
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      normalized TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'capture',
      source_agent TEXT,
      source_session TEXT,
      source_message_id TEXT,
      confidence REAL DEFAULT 0.6,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
      tags TEXT,
      created_at TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT,
      last_injected_at TEXT,
      last_confirmed_at TEXT,
      ttl_days INTEGER,
      pinned INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      superseded_by TEXT,
      concept TEXT,
      content_time TEXT,
      valid_until TEXT,
      value_score REAL,
      value_label TEXT,
      review_version TEXT,
      review_reason TEXT,
      archived_at TEXT,
      last_reviewed_at TEXT
    , source_layer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', source_path TEXT, source_line INTEGER, source_host TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gigabrain', source_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', sync_policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read_only')

tables.name: memory_beliefs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_beliefs (
      belief_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current',
      confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
      valid_from TEXT,
      valid_to TEXT,
      supersedes_belief_id TEXT,
      source_memory_id TEXT,
      source_layer TEXT,
      source_path TEXT,
      source_line INTEGER,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

tables.name: memory_claims
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_claims (
      memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      memory_tier TEXT NOT NULL,
      claim_slot TEXT NOT NULL,
      consolidation_op TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_strength TEXT NOT NULL,
      surface_candidate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )

tables.name: memory_console_metadata
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_console_metadata (
      memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      concept TEXT,
      source_message_id TEXT,
      last_injected_at TEXT,
      last_confirmed_at TEXT,
      ttl_days INTEGER CHECK (ttl_days IS NULL OR ttl_days >= 0),
      pinned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pinned IN (0, 1)),
      review_version TEXT,
      review_reason TEXT,
      FOREIGN KEY (memory_id) REFERENCES memory_current(memory_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

tables.name: memory_current
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_current (
      memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CONTEXT',
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      normalized TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      normalized_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'capture',
      source_agent TEXT,
      source_session TEXT,
      confidence REAL DEFAULT 0.6,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
      value_score REAL,
      value_label TEXT,
      created_at TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT,
      archived_at TEXT,
      last_reviewed_at TEXT,
      tags TEXT,
      superseded_by TEXT,
      content_time TEXT,
      valid_until TEXT
    , source_layer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', source_path TEXT, source_line INTEGER, source_host TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gigabrain', source_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registry', sync_policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read_only', valid_from TEXT)

tables.name: memory_embeddings
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "memory_embeddings" (

      dims        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2560,
      computed_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE memory_entities (

tables.name: memory_eval_history
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_eval_history (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      run_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      version TEXT,
      precision_at_1 REAL,
      precision_at_3 REAL,
      precision_at_5 REAL,
      mrr REAL,
      ndcg_at_5 REAL,

      case_count INTEGER,
      strategy_accuracy REAL
    , avg_injection_tokens REAL, latency_median_ms REAL, latency_p95_ms REAL)

tables.name: memory_events
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE memory_events (
      event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
      component TEXT NOT NULL,
      action TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason_codes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      memory_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      cleanup_version TEXT NOT NULL,
      run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      review_version TEXT NOT NULL,
      similarity REAL,
      matched_memory_id TEXT,
      payload TEXT
    , agent_id TEXT)

tables.name: memory_fts
tables.sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE memory_fts USING fts5(
        memory_id UNINDEXED,
        content,
        normalized,
        type UNINDEXED,
        tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'
      )
